controller_notes: IDENTITY/CONTRIBUTION RULE (independent controller audit, 2026-10-02): no public text or public field - including justification, rationale, scope, visibility and note fields, and including negative statements of the form "the facts do not contain X" - may state, list or hint at the target paper's method, its components, its contributions, its gap conclusion, its findings or results, its coined terminology, or the target paper's own dates/versions/venue.
